# LLMs and Model Mapping — arch_agent

This file documents recommended LLM providers and model mappings used by this repository (arch_agent).
Place this file in the repository root as llms.txt. Keep it up to date when you change model choices.

Summary
- Purpose: map agent roles to suggested models and record practical configuration notes for reproducibility.
- Do not commit API tokens. Use environment variables or CI secrets.

Supported providers
- Hugging Face (server or router)
  - Configure: HF_TOKEN, HF_MODEL, HF_TEMPERATURE (default 0.1), HF_MAX_TOKENS (default 2048).
  - HF_ROUTER_BASE_URL overrides the endpoint (default: https://router.huggingface.co/v1).
  - Example model id: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (fast), Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (reasoning)

- Ollama (local)
  - Configure: OLLAMA_BASE_URL, OLLAMA_MODEL, OLLAMA_NUM_PREDICT, OLLAMA_TIMEOUT, OLLAMA_THINK
  - OLLAMA_NUM_PREDICT=-1 (default) means unlimited tokens. OLLAMA_TIMEOUT caps model hang time (default 300 s).
  - OLLAMA_THINK=true enables internal <think> chain on reasoning models (e.g. deepseek-r1, qwen3); disabled by default to avoid long hangs.
  - Use for offline/local inference when available.

- GitHub Copilot
  - Configure: GITHUB_COPILOT_TOKEN (OAuth token) and GITHUB_COPILOT_MODEL
  - Default model: claude-sonnet-4.5. Other available IDs: gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4, claude-haiku-4.5, claude-opus-4.5.
  - Note: claude-* and gemini-* models require Copilot Pro+ or Enterprise. Use gh to obtain tokens: `gh auth status --show-token`.

- Bedrock (AWS)
  - Configure: set AWS_PROFILE, AWS_REGION, and BEDROCK_MODEL in .env or environment.
  - BEDROCK_MODEL accepts a full model ID or a cross-region inference profile ARN (prefix au., us., eu., ap.).
  - Legacy: ANTHROPIC_MODEL is a deprecated alias for BEDROCK_MODEL.

Agent role mapping (recommended)
- Intake (L1 — Scout / Processor)
  - Goal: deterministic structured extraction (JSON), low latency, minimal hallucination.
  - Recommended HF: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
  - Settings: HF_TEMPERATURE=0.0–0.1, HF_MAX_TOKENS low (e.g. 1024), prefer instruction-following models.

- Auditor (L3 — Strategist / Architect)
  - Goal: deep reasoning, policy analysis, synthesis.
  - Recommended HF: Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct or other large reasoning-focused model.
  - Settings: HF_MAX_TOKENS higher (e.g. 4096), HF_TEMPERATURE=0.0–0.2 depending on exploration needs.

- Policy Analyst / Other L2 roles
  - Goal: balanced reasoning and instruction following.
  - Recommended HF: mid-large models (13B–32B family) depending on cost and latency.

How to override per-agent models
- INTAKE_MODEL and AUDITOR_MODEL work across ALL providers (Bedrock, GitHub Copilot, HuggingFace, Ollama).
- You can set per-agent environment variables (see .env.example):
  - INTAKE_MODEL — overrides the provider default for the intake agent
  - AUDITOR_MODEL — overrides the provider default for the auditor agent
  - HF_MODEL — default model when LLM_PROVIDER=huggingface and no per-agent override is set
  - BEDROCK_MODEL — default model when LLM_PROVIDER=bedrock and no per-agent override is set
  - GITHUB_COPILOT_MODEL — default model when LLM_PROVIDER=github-copilot and no per-agent override is set
  - OLLAMA_MODEL — default model when LLM_PROVIDER=ollama and no per-agent override is set

Best practices
- Version Locking: always pin full model identifiers (e.g., Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct). Avoid vague names like "qwen".
- Context Hygiene: use a context reset protocol between unrelated sessions to prevent context rot.
- Prompt Engineering: place Role and Language contracts toward the top of prompts for caching and stability.
- Determinism: for structured outputs, set temperature to 0–0.1 and include strict schema instructions.

RAG and embeddings
- RAG runs as five external microservices (ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector store, context augmentation).
- Enable with USE_RAG=true and configure RAG_CONTEXT_URL / RAG_INGEST_URL etc. in .env. See docs/RAG_PIPELINE.md.
- For large document sets, chunk documents and use semantic retrieval to stay within context limits.

Security
- Never commit API tokens or secrets. .env is ignored by default. Use GitHub Actions secrets for CI.
- If a token is accidentally exposed, rotate it immediately and, if needed, scrub history.
